Name: Elle's Old Barn Animals
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]

- Several different skins for each barn animal to choose from!
      - 45 skins for brown and white cows (including deer)
      - 60 skins for goats (including deer)
      - 25 skins for sheep (including alpacas)
      - 46 skins for pigs (including deer)
      - 9 skins for ostriches
- Replacement of the icons in Marnie's shop
- Wool and cloth item recolors (note that these are the same items you get from your rabbits, but change with your sheep color)
- The ability to disable any animal replacement in the config.json for compatibility with other mods

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]﻿

[b][color=#e69138]1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close.
[color=#e69138][b]5[/b][/color]. Open the config.json and use the images in the References folder to change each animal to the texture name you prefer! To disable a retexture, change its value to "False"
[color=#e69138][b]6[/b][/color]. Run the game using SMAP!

To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.

[b][color=#e69138]Optional[/color][/b]: I have also included an optional folder of skins for use with the [u][color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n Skin[/url][/color][/u] mod! This will let you use more variants of animals on your farm, including cats and dogs. Note that if you use A&S, you should only use the skins, not the main download.

To use, extract the skins folder into Adopt 'n Skin's assets folder and merge it. I have included all skins shown here; simply delete the ones you don't want to use! Deer are included as skins for cows, pigs, and goats.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿

1.1.1 - Added Ostrich replacements
          - Added optional wool and cloth recolors (enabled by default, change with your Sheep config)
1.1.0 - Changed mod to a single download with a config.json
          - Updated all sprites to match the rendering style of my newer mods
          - Changed the dark brown variant colors
          - Added another color (light grey) to the spotted/hereford/etc variants 
          - Added belted cows
          - Added deer as options for the goat and pig
          - Reworked the patterns of the different variants
          - Changed the deer colors to the palette the rest of the animals use
          - Changed the face on the front-facing sprites of the baby pig
          - Changed the eye position on the side view sprite of the pig
          - Changed the head on all sheep sprites and baby alpaca sprites
          - Smoothed the back of the baby sheep
